basics.name: Ali Jamali
basics.title: Data Analyst | Data Administrator | SQL & Reporting
summaries: IT professional based in Metro Vancouver, BC, with extensive experience in healthcare data, SQL Server, reporting and technology support.
I help teams organize complex information, investigate data issues and build reliable reporting environments. My work includes centralized data and KPIs across approximately 20–25 hospitals.
basics.metaDescription: Ali Jamali: healthcare data, SQL Server, reporting and IT professional in Metro Vancouver, BC. Explore experience, projects, skills and certifications.

paragraphs: My background combines data administration, SQL reporting, healthcare applications and hands-on IT support. I have worked with hospital information systems, database migrations, integrations and operational reporting in healthcare environments.

I bring an analytical and methodical approach to investigating inconsistencies, validating information and resolving database and application issues. Accuracy, documentation and clear communication with users and technical teams are central to how I work.

Based in Metro Vancouver, BC, I am seeking opportunities in data analysis, data administration, database support, reporting and related roles. I continue learning Microsoft Power BI, Azure database administration and Microsoft Fabric/data topics.

responsibilities: Provide project-based IT support for computer systems, software and user technical issues.
Install, configure and troubleshoot Windows systems, applications and network connectivity.
Support data backup, recovery, file management and system maintenance.
Diagnose hardware, software and performance issues and recommend appropriate solutions.
Assist clients with system setup, updates, security and general technical support.
Document technical issues, completed work and solutions for follow-up.

Collaborated with hospital and technical teams to resolve data issues.

Developed T-SQL queries, stored procedures, functions and Crystal Reports.
Investigated database, application, data-processing and performance issues.

Developed C# healthcare applications, integrations and data interfaces.
